description: GKE us-west1 SSD_TOTAL_GB quota (500GB) is the cluster's scaling ceiling: each Autopilot node consumes ~100GB pd-balanced boot disk, so 4 nodes + PVCs exhausts it and NAP scale-ups fail with QUOTA_EXCEEDED (MIG list-errors on the gk3-warren NAP group shows it; autoscaler then backs off ~35min). Run pods pinned to us-west1-b by the warren-repo-cache zonal PV can strand Pending even when other zones have capacity. Separately: plan-run child_pr_merge_timeout failures on 2026-07-22 night were the 30-min DEFAULT_MERGE_TIMEOUT_MS in effect before the 03:09Z redeploy — not the quota.
resolution: Quota preference SSD-TOTAL-GB-per-project-region updated to preferred 1000 with justification on 2026-07-23 (prior 750 ask denied 2026-07-21; check gcloud alpha quotas preferences list if scale-ups fail again). Merge timeouts fixed by WARREN_PLAN_RUN_MERGE_TIMEOUT_MS=14400000 deployed 03:09Z 2026-07-23.

description: Two distinct finalize_failed shapes hit the live k8s instance in one dogfood session (2026-07-30): (1) pod reached terminal phase without posting in-pod finalize (run_pnknyar9yw3d — watchdog idle-reconcile after 13min-silent check:all, providerPhase=succeeded); (2) branch push rejected by GitHub secret scanning over a realistic vendor-key test fixture (run_m6br4vntg007). In k8s mode workspace_destroy_skipped preserved nothing (volume dies with the pod) — both runs' completed work was unrecoverable, ~$10.66 lost. Trackers: warren-3047, warren-3920, warren-b68d; salvage feature merged as #685 (warren-cd3b).
resolution: Re-dispatch fresh with cause-specific prompt constraints: build secret-shaped fixtures from concatenated parts (defeats push protection — retry succeeded, PR #683) and stream output during long gates so the event stream is never silent 10+ min. Both retries landed.

name: dogfood-pipeline-shepherding
description: Dogfood pipeline pattern proven again on pl-1c02 (11/11 issues landed, PRs #673-#686): serial dispatch with seedId, expect EVERY PR that outlives another merge to need shepherding — .seeds/issues.jsonl conflicts on essentially every PR pair. Cheap repair runs (ref=targetBranch=PR head branch, explicit both-sides conflict rules, 'do NOT push/open PR') cost $0.20-0.75 each and fixed 6/6 conflicts. Always instruct repair runs to dedup issues.jsonl (jq -r .id | sort | uniq -d must be empty) — git ort silently duplicates rows (warren-a71f class, caught live once). Issues whose spec depends on gitignored local-only files (local-planning/) cannot go to cloud agents — run those as local subagents in worktrees reading the main checkout via absolute path.
